name: Garasu no Konpeitou
source:
Ogikubo Nemuri is a maid who worked for Madam Karen, the wife of a Imperial Japanese naval colonel.

One day, under government orders, the husband was stationed at a war plant to undertake manual labor. As a result, his family and Nemuri moved to the plant to live-in and work there.

Nemuri was concerned about the sickly Madam Karen, as well as the soldier she fatefully encountered; a soldier named Gunjouji Mayato, who was also the commanding officer at the plant in which Madam Karen's husband worked at...

[Translation of [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ249478.html]DL Site's plot summary[/url].]
translation:
荻洼根梦是一名女仆，为日本帝国海军上校的妻子卡伦夫人工作。

有一天，按照政府的命令，丈夫被派驻到一家军工厂从事体力劳动。于是，他的家人和根穆里搬到了工厂居住和工作。

根穆里很关心体弱多病的凯伦夫人，以及她命运中遇到的士兵。军城寺玛雅托（Gunjouji Mayato）是一名士兵，也是卡伦女士丈夫工作的工厂的指挥官……

[[url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ249478.html]DL Site剧情概要的翻译[/url].]
